To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the volume of trading by large commodity pools is significantly and positively related to the price volatility of the 36 futures markets analyzed.

(a) the relationship between futures price volatility and commodity pool trading is statistically insignificant in the 72 estimated regression equations, and (b) the coefficient on commodity trading volume is significantly negative in only 4 of the 72 estimated equations.
(1) the volume of commodity pool trading is positively related to the volatility of futures prices and (2) this relationship does not hold in the case of commodity pool trading.

the impact of managed funds and commodity pools on futures market volatility.
